notes.1.1: A letter to the dead. Line 1: which name is the sender and which the recipient is uncertain. Line 2: rrj is unexplained (perhaps 'pleasant'); mꜣn! is marked as a scribal oddity for mꜣꜣ 'see'; jw,wt 'wrongs' is partly restored. Line 3: ꜥby is unexplained. Line 5: zp=f, 'his case', is uncertain, and so is the subject of mꜣꜣ. jm mꜣꜣ=snj may instead be jmi̯, 'let': 'Let them see his case.'

nodes.text: A letter to Hetepnebi and Tetiseneb.
Is it pleasant(?) for you to see these wrongs while you are here?
Yet your excellence is yours here, ... (*ꜥby*) your children.
So seize this dead man and this dead woman!
Let them not see his case, since there is no one here who raises his voice against you.
